// Generate complete HTML report for PDF generation const reportData = $input.first().json; const htmlContent = ` Due Diligence Report: ${reportData.company_name}

Due Diligence Report

${reportData.company_name}

${reportData.website || 'Website not provided'}

Introduction & Engagement Context

${reportData.introduction_engagement_context || 'Not available'}

Methodology & Reliability Levels

${reportData.methodology_reliability_levels || 'Not available'}

Company Overview

${reportData.company_overview || 'Not available'}

Business Model & Unit Economics

${reportData.business_model_unit_economics || 'Not available'}

Products & Technology

${reportData.products_technology || 'Not available'}

Target Market & Competitive Set

${reportData.target_market_competitive_set || 'Not available'}

Financials (Multi-Year, Reconciled & Recomputed)

${reportData.financials_multi_year || 'Not available'}

Cash Burn & Runway

${reportData.cash_burn_runway || 'Not available'}

Revenue Quality & Client Cohorts

${reportData.revenue_quality_client_cohorts || 'Not available'}

Partnerships & Ecosystem

${reportData.partnerships_ecosystem || 'Not available'}

Intellectual Property

${reportData.intellectual_property || 'Not available'}

Legal & Regulatory

${reportData.legal_regulatory || 'Not available'}

Governance & Board Effectiveness

${reportData.governance_board_effectiveness || 'Not available'}

Capital Structure & Dilution

${reportData.capital_structure_dilution || 'Not available'}

Risk Matrix & Mitigations

${reportData.risk_matrix_mitigations || 'Not available'}

Gaps, Uncertainties & Disclaimers

${reportData.gaps_uncertainties_disclaimers || 'Not available'}

Scenario Analysis

${reportData.scenario_analysis || 'Not available'}

Strategic Options

${reportData.strategic_options || 'Not available'}

Recommendations & Next Steps

${reportData.recommendations_next_steps || 'Not available'}

Source Map & Integrity Log

${reportData.source_map_integrity_log || 'Not available'}

Report Generated: ${new Date().toISOString()}

Company: ${reportData.company_name}

Kanboard Task ID: ${reportData.kanboard_task_id}

Attachments: ${reportData.attachment_info || 'None'}

`; return [{ json: { ...reportData, htmlContent: htmlContent, pdfFilename: `DD_Report_${reportData.company_name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_')}_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.pdf` } }];
